### T-068 — A data module inside the s3 test layer makes the loader log an error

> _2026-09-10 · test/blong-int-adapter · open_

`test/blong-int-adapter/s3/test/fixtures/object.ts` is a plain data module sitting inside the
`test/` layer, so the loader logs
`Error loading ... probably a generic source code was put in a handler group folder`. It is benign,
because the module is imported directly by the CRUD test, and it pre-dates the restructure, but
moving it out of the layer would silence the warning.
